t2.thesis: NVDA enters earnings after a sharp ~27% one-month drawdown and a surprise CEO resignation, with a large implied move of ~8.8% and no clear directional edge, so the outcome stays near the base rate with a slight lean toward a relief bounce.
reasons: Base rate for AMC/ai_infra events is ~54-56%, while semis cluster is lower at 48%, which roughly nets out to ~54%.

Stock is down ~27% in a month and ~35% from its 52w high at ~9.9x forward PE, so expectations are depressed and strong guidance ($108B guide, supply commitments up to $279B) could trigger a relief rally.

CEO Huang's abrupt resignation and a widening scandal add large uncertainty; the entry open on 11/17 already prices in much of the news, but any CEO-comeback or clarification on the call is a two-sided tail.
Options imply ~8.8% move with call/put IV roughly balanced (put skew mild), so no directional signal from options; recent 4-print history is 50% win rate.
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 guide vs. elevated whisper (above ~$108B plus Q4 commentary) and management's handling of the CEO transition and Huang's possible return on the call.

prior.from: Overall buy-everything hit rate ~54.2% (validation); AMC 53.8%; ai_infra cluster 55.8%, semis 47.9%

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-16, so that earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information about how NVDA's stock moved afterward.
t2.moved_from_prior: No net move from the 54% prior: oversold/cheap valuation and a beat-and-raise pattern (+0.5 to +1pt) are offset by the leadership-crisis uncertainty and a weak AI/semis tape (-0.5 to -1pt).

theses.expected: Relief rally: beat-and-raise with Kress reassuring on continuity lifts the beaten-down stock at the next open.
theses.mechanism: Depressed positioning and low forward PE mean good guidance gets rewarded; the leadership overhang partly clears.
theses.wrong_if: Guide is only in line with the whisper or the call reveals more governance or scandal detail.

theses.expected: Sell the news: strong numbers but the stock falls as the scandal and AI-capex financing concerns dominate.
theses.mechanism: Circular financing, large guarantees (OpenAI, SB Energy) and supply commitments raise worries; the AI sell-off continues.
theses.wrong_if: Data center revenue and guide beat meaningfully and the broad AI tape stabilizes.

theses.expected: Muted or mixed move with the gap mostly set by the pre-earnings drift on 11/17.
theses.mechanism: The entry open on 11/17 already reflects Monday's weakness and any rebound, so the earnings gap is a coin flip around the implied move.
theses.wrong_if: A decisive surprise in either direction produces a move well beyond 8.8%.

key_observations: Q3 revenue guide versus ~$108B and the Q4 commentary
Data center revenue and gross margin (~74-75%)
Any statement on Huang's role, a return, or the CEO search timeline
Supply constraints, China assumptions and customer financing commitments
Size and direction of the 11/17 open versus Monday's close
t2.method: D004 v4: leak-probe call without the dossier, then one decision call on the frozen dossier; no tools
